limitations_and_boundaries: The review highlights that many proposed regulatory signals (e.g., GPCR, Mevalonate pathway, BMP/Smad crosstalk) lack in vivo genetic validation in Drosophila or mice.
The role of adherens junctions in directly regulating YAP/TAZ remains controversial.
The mechanism by which Yorkie senses tissue damage is unclear.
Further work is needed to establish which RTKs are genetically required to regulate YAP/TAZ in different tissues.
